keywords: Criminal appeal – Double murder – Circumstantial evidence – Accused finding wife with another man – Initial assault and later fatal episode distinguished – Other accused originally indicted and later discharged – Prosecution required to exclude reasonable possibility that another person committed killings – Incomplete chain of circumstances – Trial judge failed adequately to address possible third-party participation – Grave and sudden provocation/sudden fight also raised – Presumption of innocence – Separate counts and sentencing.
legistation: Code of Criminal Procedure Act No. 15 of 1979 – section 331; Penal Code provisions governing murder and grave and sudden provocation; principles governing proof by circumstantial evidence.
